SQL:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  WHERE
    (
      orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND orders.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    )
    AND CASE
      WHEN customers.tags IS NULL OR 'vip' IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE LIST_CONTAINS([__slayer_e FOR __slayer_e IN customers.tags IF __slayer_e IS NOT NULL], 'vip')
    END
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), shifted__time_shift_inner AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  WHERE
    CASE
      WHEN customers.tags IS NULL OR 'vip' IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE LIST_CONTAINS([__slayer_e FOR __slayer_e IN customers.tags IF __slayer_e IS NOT NULL], 'vip')
    END
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), sjoin__time_shift_inner AS (
  SELECT
    base."orders.order_date",
    base."orders.revenue",
    shifted__time_shift_inner."orders.revenue" AS "orders._time_shift_inner"
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN shifted__time_shift_inner
    ON base."orders.order_date" - INTERVAL 1 MONTH IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted__time_shift_inner."orders.order_date"
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.revenue",
    "orders._time_shift_inner",
    "orders.revenue" - "orders._time_shift_inner" AS "orders.revenue_change"
  FROM sjoin__time_shift_inner
)
SELECT
  "orders.order_date",
  "orders.revenue",
  "orders.revenue_change"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.revenue",
    "orders._time_shift_inner",
    "orders.revenue_change"
  FROM step1
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "orders.order_date" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message: Here is the 2025 monthly revenue from orders placed by customers tagged 'vip', with each month's change from the month before. January's change of +622.32 compares against December 2024. All orders count regardless of status, so the 'bad' ones are included too. The biggest swing is November: revenue fell to 1,833.11, down 2,772.47 from October, then rose by 2,663.94 in December.
